# Blender

> > Blender is a free and open-source 3D creation suite supporting modeling, animation, rendering, compositing, and VFX, developed by the Blender Foundation and community.

Blender.org serves as the official hub for Blender software, featuring major release announcements, development updates, industry partnerships, and community showcases. The site highlights the Blender Development Fund, enterprise support through partnerships like Canonical and AWS, and real-world applications from film production to scientific visualization.

## Key Topics

- Blender Foundation
- Ton Roosendaal
- Blender Development Fund
- Cycles renderer
- Open-source 3D software
- Blender LTS (Long-term Support)
- Geometry Nodes
- Code Quest
- Enterprise support
- Film and VFX production
- Community contributions
- Release cycles
- Blender Institute
- Open-source funding models

## Major Releases & Announcements

- [Blender 3.0, a new era for content creation](https://www.blender.org/press/blender-3-0-a-new-era-for-content-creation): Blender 3.0 release announcement marking new era for 3D creation
- [Announcing Blender 2.8 Code Quest](https://www.blender.org/press/announcing-blender-2-8-code-quest): Blender Foundation announces 2.8 Code Quest crowdfunding campaign
- [Code Quest Campaign: A Success Story](https://www.blender.org/press/code-quest-campaign-a-success-story): Blender 2.8 Code Quest crowdfunding campaign success story

## Enterprise & Development Fund

- [AWS joins the Blender Development Fund](https://www.blender.org/press/aws-joins-the-blender-development-fund): AWS becomes Patron Member of Blender Development Fund
- [Canonical Offering Blender Support](https://www.blender.org/press/canonical-offering-blender-support): Canonical partners with Blender Foundation for enterprise LTS support
- [Thanks!](https://www.blender.org/thanks): Donation thank you page for Blender Foundation funding support

## Industry Impact & User Stories

- [Blender's impact in film](https://www.blender.org/news/blenders-impact-in-film): Jim Thacker recounts Blender's 20-year impact on film industry
- [Blender and the Rabbids](https://www.blender.org/user-stories/blender-and-the-rabbids): Ubisoft Film & Television uses Blender for Rabbids Invasion production
- [Cosmology with Geometry Nodes](https://www.blender.org/user-stories/cosmology-with-geometry-nodes): Geometry Nodes used for cosmology research visualization at university
- [TNT Drama Series 'Legends' Teaser](https://www.blender.org/press/tnt-drama-series-legends-teaser): Loica studio uses Blender and 3D scanning for TNT's Legends promo

## Community & Foundation News

- [Blender by the Numbers – 2020](https://www.blender.org/news/blender-by-the-numbers-2020): 2020 annual report with download metrics and development fund statistics
- [Reinforcing the Blender Trademark Guidelines](https://www.blender.org/news/reinforcing-the-blender-trademark-guidelines): Blender Foundation updates trademark policy and branding guidelines
- [Taking a break to recover](https://www.blender.org/news/taking-a-break-to-recover): Ton Roosendaal health update and leadership transition announcement
- [Credits](https://www.blender.org/about/credits): Contributors and development team credits for Blender 5.0
- [Media Creation Tools at FOSDEM 2026](https://www.blender.org/events/media-creation-tools-at-fosdem-2026): FOSDEM 2026 Media Creation Tools Devroom call for participation
